# YouSafe Marketplace

> Fixed-price service discovery for the United States, the United Kingdom, Canada, and Australia. Listings cover immigration help, document preparation, and tenancy help. Provider scope varies by listing.

YouSafe Consultancy is not a law firm. Legal advice comes only from independently engaged licensed attorneys. Legal procedural guides belong on the legal site, not on Marketplace.

## What this site is

- [YouSafe Marketplace](https://market.yousafeconsultancy.com/) — commerce and service discovery for fixed-price listings.
- [File shop](https://market.yousafeconsultancy.com/shop) — workbooks, templates, and short guides. Pay once, download immediately.
- Regional informational sites: [USA](https://usa.yousafeconsultancy.com), [Canada](https://ca.yousafeconsultancy.com), [UK](https://uk.yousafeconsultancy.com), [Australia](https://au.yousafeconsultancy.com).
- [Legal procedural guides](https://legal.yousafeconsultancy.com) — legal and procedural articles. They are not Marketplace commerce pages.
- Portal links are account utilities: [client sign-in](https://portal.yousafeconsultancy.com/sign-in/student), [apply as attorney](https://portal.yousafeconsultancy.com/sign-up/attorney).
